_comment: Root TypeScript config for the nyx v2 monorepo (PDR-0006). It carries no files of its own. The two TS build units of the single desktop product extend tsconfig.base.json: the Electron shell (apps/desktop/tsconfig.json, typecheck-only via `tsc --noEmit`) and its co-located React renderer (apps/desktop/renderer/tsconfig.json, bundled by Vite). Typecheck the whole JS side with `bun run check`.
